# Summary

Ph.D. student in photonics with hands-on silicon nitride (SiN) integrated photonics experience across the design flow: script-based layout in Python (gdsfactory, PhotonForge, KLayout), FDTD simulation (Tidy3D), foundry-PDK tape-out (Ligentec MPW), and optical characterization of fabricated passive circuits. Background in scattering-matrix and network modeling of large photonic systems and in programmable photonic circuits (MZI meshes, ring resonators) for optical computing. Uses AI-assisted, agentic coding workflows in daily development.

# Research Experience

## SiN photonic integrated circuits: design, layout, and tape-out

- Scripted the tape-out layout of topological unitary circuits in PhotonForge with the Ligentec SiN PDK (plus gdsfactory, KLayout) for a multi-project-wafer (MPW) run; chips are in fabrication.
- Designed SiN devices for non-Abelian braiding of light with coupled-mode theory (CMT), verified them in Tidy3D FDTD, and optically characterized the in-house-fabricated passive circuits.
- Goal: programmable control of light that is robust to fabrication imperfections, using non-Abelian topology.

## Programmable photonic circuits for optical computing

- Co-invented a 2×2 nonlinear unitary optical device for optical neural networks: an MZI couples two channels, each a waveguide with a side-coupled resonator tuned thermo- or electro-optically, giving power-preserving Kerr nonlinearity (KR patent registered; US and EP applications published).
- Co-first author of a review of programmable photonic unitary circuits (MZI meshes, Fourier-type and synthetic-frequency architectures) and their fidelity--scalability trade-offs (*Nanophotonics*, 2025).

## Scalable modeling and design of large-scale disordered photonic media

- Developed a hypergraph-compression model of wave scattering that designs disordered optical materials with $O(N^{1/L})$ time complexity, beyond the conventional $O(N)$ limit: $10^6$-particle systems from 300 seed particles, and nearly 100$\times$ higher design accuracy in a hybrid with collective-coordinate optimization (first author; method, all numerical analysis, and \href{https://github.com/KunwooPark/Scattering-Hypergraph}{public Python code}).
- Developed network-based models and inverse-design methods for disordered and non-Hermitian scattering media, with ensemble statistics over random realizations (*Adv. Opt. Mater.* 2026; CLEO-PR 2024; SPIE 2025).

# Technical Skills

- **Layout and tape-out:** PhotonForge, gdsfactory (Python), KLayout; Ligentec SiN PDK, MPW tape-out
- **Photonic simulation:** Tidy3D (FDTD; primary tool), COMSOL Multiphysics; coupled-mode theory (CMT)
- **Programming:** Python (layout and simulation automation); agentic coding (Claude Code, Codex)
- **Devices:** SiN waveguides, MZIs and MZI meshes, microring resonators, thermo-/electro-optic phase shifters
- **Modeling:** Scattering-matrix and network (graph/hypergraph) models, inverse design, ensemble statistics
- **Experiment:** Optical characterization of passive integrated photonic circuits
